title: Jim Harbaugh: In retrospect, I wish we'd gotten guys more preseason reps

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Jim Harbaugh: In retrospect, I wish we'd gotten guys more preseason reps
sources.description: The Chargers had one of the most disappointing debut performances and it left head coach Jim Harbaugh with some second thoughts about how the team prepared for the start of the regular season.
